summary: Agent confirmed and the system recorded a refund without completing the required full verification for refunds/returns (username/email and order ID). No other policy violations were found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: I have sent the refund. Is there anything else I can help you with?
findings.explanation: The agent confirms the refund was sent (turn 26). The system log shows a refund was made (turn 24). Full verification is required before refunds/returns (username, email address and order ID). The agent asked for full name, account ID and order ID in turn 6, but the customer only provided an account ID in turn 7. The refund was processed without completing the required verification (missing username/email and order ID). This is a major violation because an order action (refund) was taken with incomplete verification.
